description: This file defines the AOW_WorkFlowDashlet class, a custom dashlet for the SuiteCRM platform. The class extends DashletGeneric and includes initialization code that loads dashlet metadata, sets the title, search fields, columns, and seed bean for the dashlet.

classes.name: AOW_WorkFlowDashlet
classes.description: A class representing a custom dashlet in SuiteCRM for displaying AOW_WorkFlow records.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method that initializes the dashlet object, loads metadata, sets default title if unset, and defines search fields, columns, and seed bean.
